responsibility: Implements the standard and default channel manager on top of FIO, RTio, RTfio, and the generic RTgen device stack. It allocates a dedicated device id for standard channels, maps FIO.StdIn/StdOut/StdErr into channel records with full text/raw hooks, tracks both immutable standard channels and mutable default in/out/err bindings, exposes null and redirection operations, and performs buffered flushing and safe device teardown during finalization.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the runtime realization of the StdChans interface from StdChans.def, creating the standard-channel device instances, maintaining default-channel variables, and handling flushing/teardown rather than merely declaring the accessors and setters.
